QUOTE: "**Default build (`MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` off, the shipped default):** `include/mbedtls/platform.h:166-167` defines `mbedtls_calloc` as `calloc` and `mbedtls_free` as `free`. The call is libc `calloc`, resolved at compile time."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that in the default build mbedtls_calloc/mbedtls_free are compile-time defines to calloc/free, resolved at compile time with no runtime hook.
